messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Latency SLO breach detected in router.ingress (eu-west-1). p99 > 2.5s for last 5m. Paging oncall.

alex: Sara oncall for EU, FYI. Looks like p99 has been climbing since 09:11 UTC.

sara: I'm on it. Acknowledged. Pulling dashboards now.

ethan: Quick snapshot from the dashboard: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.8s, median ~ 80ms. Streaming stalls (codec:stream) up ~6x relative to baseline.

priya: Any recent routing changes? I see a routing policy rollout earlier this morning (09:10 UTC) that adjusted per-zone weights for the new hash-preserve policy.

mike: That change was the canary for LB v2. Commit: 8f3c2a4 (deploy 09:08 UTC). It adjusted prefer-local weights and enabled hotkey-preserver flag for some routes.

ops-bot: Deploy 8f3c2a4 succeeded in prod at 2026-03-15T09:08:17Z.

alex: Logs show elevated "route_misassign" traces. Example: 
```
[09:12:43] route_misassign: shard=shard-42 assigned_to=eu-west-1b dest=eu-west-1a latency=3145ms
```

priya: Heatmap from routing-telemetry: shard-42 is receiving 12x baseline fanout. Region skew: eu-west-1a showing 72% of the shard traffic despite even split configured.

ethan: KQL for the last 10m: 
```
metrics | where service=="router.ingress" and region=="eu-west-1" | summarize p95=percentile(latency,95), p99=percentile(latency,99) by minute
```
Gives p99 spike aligning with 09:11-09:15 window.

sara: Suspect misrouting from new policy causing hot partition -> tail latency. Prioritize rollback of the canary routing policy to confirm.

priya: Agreed. Proposed mitigation steps: 
1) Disable hotkey-preserver flag on routing service (quick toggle).
2) Roll back policy weights to previous commit 7b2a9d1.
3) Temporarily enable fallback to regional-pool for streaming routes.

mike: I can rollback weights now. Running: 
```
./rtrctl rollback-policy --commit 7b2a9d1 --scope eu-west-1 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: Rollback command accepted, executing.

mike: Done. Rollback applied at 09:17:02 UTC. Confirming route table convergence.

priya: I toggled hotkey-preserver=false on the routing config (09:17:15 UTC). Also flipped prefer-local back to legacy behavior for the canary cohort.

ethan: Early telemetry (09:18-09:20): p99 falling from 2.8s -> 1.1s, p95 stable ~380ms. Streaming stalls count dropping to 1.7x baseline.

sara: Customer impact: We saw a small number of streaming timeouts affecting mid-tier accounts; CS reported one customer (acme-inc) with degraded session throughput. Logged and escalated to CSM.

alex: Good catch. Keep an eye for recurrence and check for any residual hotkey state in shards (KV cache sticky entries).

priya: We'll run a rebalancer job to redistribute hot shard keys gradually to avoid thundering. Job started at 09:22 UTC. Command: 
```
./rebalancer --shard shard-42 --target=eu-west-1-{a,b,c} --max-rate=200/s
```

ethan: Alerting note: Create a temporary alert for routing skew > 3x per-shard for 3m to catch regressions.

sara: I'll keep the incident open for 2h for observation and then do a handoff to night team if stable. Assigning postmortem owner: priya.

mike: Action items recorded: 
- priya: postmortem + RCA (policy validation gap)
- ethan: add skew alert + dashboard panel for per-shard heatmap
- alex: validate KV cache eviction behavior during rebalancer run
- sara: coordinate CS comms for impacted customers

ops-bot: Incident severity set to SEV-2. Handoff scheduled at 11:30 UTC if no regressions.

sara: Leaving a note for oncall night: watch p99 and streaming stalls, and don't re-enable hotkey-preserver or prefer-local until follow-up allows.

priya: Quick ETA: postmortem draft by EOD, I'll include deploy timeline and policy diff.

alex: Thanks team. All thumbs if we're stable? :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup: monitoring window looks green for now. Will update if anything comes back.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged closed to PUT_ON_HOLD state pending observation.
